name: Unwinding Anxiety
one_liner: Unwinding Anxiety is a paid app of short daily mindfulness lessons by psychiatrist Judson Brewer that treats worry as a habit you can unlearn.
best_for: Adults with ongoing worry or generalized anxiety who want a structured daily program
People who like learning mindfulness through short lessons rather than long meditations
People whose employer or health plan provides it free
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want a free option (there is no free tier after the trial)
People with severe anxiety, panic or PTSD who need therapy or medication from a clinician
short_description: Daily mindfulness lessons for worry and anxiety by Judson Brewer (Sharecare). 7-day trial, then $29.99/month or $209.99/year; one RCT.
long_description: Unwinding Anxiety is an app-based mindfulness program developed by psychiatrist and researcher Judson Brewer and now owned by Sharecare. It delivers short daily lessons (videos, animations and exercises) built on the idea that worry is a habit loop, plus in-the-moment practices, a journal, a member community and weekly live calls. It costs $29.99 a month, $139.99 for six months or $209.99 a year after a 7-day free trial, and employers, health plans and public programs can buy licenses. In a 2021 randomized trial in the Journal of Medical Internet Research, 65 adults with generalized anxiety disorder were assigned to the app or usual care; anxiety (GAD-7) dropped 67% with the app versus 14% with usual care at two months. The trial was small, recruited online, and two authors were paid advisers to the app's owner. The app uses Sharecare's privacy policy, which says data outside employer programs may go to ad exchanges.
patient_summary: You work through about 30 short daily video lessons and in-the-moment exercises that teach you to notice the worry habit loop and step out of it, with a community and weekly live calls. After a 7-day free trial it costs $29.99 a month, $139.99 for 6 months or $209.99 a year; some employers and health plans provide it. One small randomized trial in people with generalized anxiety disorder found a large drop in anxiety after two months.

pricing.notes: Also $139.99 for 6 months; a lifetime plan is listed on the pricing page (price not confirmed). Employers, health plans and public programs can buy bulk licenses.

privacy.notes: Uses Sharecare's privacy policy: no sale of personal information in its Enterprise (employer/plan) program, but outside it data can go to ad exchanges. HIPAA applies only where the sponsor is a covered entity.

seo.title: Unwinding Anxiety: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Unwinding Anxiety is a mindfulness-based program for worry and anxiety habits, with daily lessons, exercises and weekly live calls.

faqs.q: How much does Unwinding Anxiety cost?
faqs.a: 7-day trial, then $29.99/month or $209.99/year. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Unwinding Anxiety before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Unwinding Anxiety replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Unwinding Anxiety is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use Unwinding Anxiety?
faqs.a: Unwinding Anxiety is available on iPhone and Android.
Daily guided lessons; Mindfulness exercises; Weekly live calls; Community and journal.

citation.title: Clinical Efficacy and Psychological Mechanisms of an App-Based Digital Therapeutic for Generalized Anxiety Disorder: Randomized Controlled Trial

clinical_trials.outcome: GAD-7 anxiety fell 67% with the app vs 14% with usual care at 2 months (median change -8.5 vs -1.0); 46% completed the program. Small, online-recruited; two authors were paid advisers to the app's owner. NCT03683472.
